main.description: A prize, honour, or competitive distinction. Separate from id.career.grant because an award recognises past work while a grant funds future work, and CVs list them in different sections with different sort orders.

name.description: Equal language variants of the award name as it should be printed.

conferredBy.description: Awarding body: society, conference, institution, or government.

category.description: Equal language variants of the sub-category.

forWork.description: StrongRef to the pub.paper.reference that was recognised, for paper awards.

forPresentation.description: StrongRef to the id.career.presentation that was recognised, for best-poster and best-talk awards.

amount.description: Prize money, where it is publicly known and the recipient wishes to state it.

selectionPool.description: Selectivity as stated by the awarding body, e.g. '1 of 480 submissions'. Never computed, only quoted.
